title: JPN: Times Car reporting ¥5.5 billion loss has firms bracing for data breach fallout
content_md: Maddie Baker and Spencer Landers As cyberattacks continue across Japan, companies are coming to realize the great financial risk of such attacks if their lax cybersecurity systems cause millions of peoples’ personal information to be leaked.
